So now the question is, do we see something similar? Do we see an ascension into the afternoon before we get that? Or do now we start seeing some of that profit taking in anticipation of that Fomc meeting i will say right now ada has fallen below this 200 uh ma on the 15 minute chart so that's definitely something worth noting btc still floating around uh 74k we are actually building a little bit of a bull pennant here i almost lost my train i thought uh building a bit of a bull pennant here. So again, we should see some movement breach one way or the other for BTC by that point, either to the upside or the downside, depending on mostly Jerome Powell's words following this. But have a great day. Catch you guys in the next one. Take care.
